newsitem.title: USA: Ergo says Ergoset diabetes trial positive.
newsitem.headline: Ergo says Ergoset diabetes trial positive.

text.p: Ergo Science Corp said Friday that results for Phase III clinical trials of Ergoset for Type II diabetes were positive.
Of the 122 subjects who completed the trial, 60 received Ergoset and showed a statistically significant 0.6 percent reduction in glycated hemoglobin, compared to placebo, Ergo said.
According to the company, glycated hemoglobin is the primary measure of blood glucose control used by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to determine the efficacy of drug candidates in diabetics.
In the study, Ergoset was generally well-tolerated being administered orally, once a day, on a timed basis for a 24-week period, Ergo said.
It said it plans to have a meeting with the FDA in the first quarter next year and submit an New Drug Application in mid-1997.
